findings.problem: The sidecar and its write temp are not reserved against the canonical campaign path. A valid trusted profile configuration can cause a bonus commit to overwrite or remove the main save.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject normalized canonical main path equal to sidecar final OR sidecar.tmp before loading/begin/write; revoke the colliding binding. Keep ordinary profile file behavior unchanged.
findings.acceptance: Run the exact QA probe against fixed code; both begin/complete must be denied and valid main bytes/schema retained, including normalized ./ aliases. Preserve existing once/crash/replay/profile negative controls.
